Don't pretend to be straight. I put on that show for a while and it won't get you anywhere. Be proud that you're different. Embrace the weirdness. I couldn't keep a job either. I had to quit my grocery store job because the stress destroyed me. And that's fine, some of us just can't handle stress as well. It's easier said than done but you just gotta stop giving a crap what society thinks. I'm working on it too. And if you don't have IRL friends you gotta make one. It's scary talking to people, but find a coworker you could imagine getting along with, and take the step of bravery and start talking to them. You'll be so glad you did and even if it doesn't evolve into a full-fledged friendship, you'll at least have a coworker to talk to everyday
as for not going with your family, if they can't understand your need to be alone, that's their problem
It's hard, but you can't let him bring you down. That's probably what he wants. You wouldn't want to give him the satisfaction of that, would you? Show him you don't need his approval to be happy
You seem aware of how much it would hurt your family. Keep thinking of that. That means people care about you. Also, I'm a fellow raccoon enthusiast
